svg.text: Arduino Uno + 4 servos. Uno on its own 9 V battery; 12 V adapter → XL4015 buck at 5.8 V → servos only. All grounds are joined.
C = 1000 µF ≥10 V on the servo rail
MG996R + / − go straight to the buck
servo plug: brown = GND · red = + · orange = signal · 300 mm extension leads for lift, wrist, gripper
clip → barrel plug in Uno jack
is fine: above 6.6 V on VIN
the Uno turns USB power off
